extracted.intended_audience: Boston-area writers, community members, and patrons interested in free creative writing workshops
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement and description of a neighborhood creative-writing program (Write Down the Street) offering free, local workshops (drop-in and a six-week bilingual course) aimed at broad community participation and inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free access to workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Offer free creative writing workshops at BPL’s Egleston Square and Mattapan branches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All programs and exhibitions at the Boston Public Library are free and open to the public; funding from the Calderwood Foundation supports expansion and free teen drop-in workshops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Low-commitment drop-in classes
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants can choose from low-commitment drop-in classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drop-in sessions allow flexible attendance and focus on a single theme per session; they are designed for accessibility and to encourage casual participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Six-week bilingual writing workshop
rubrics_metrics.description: A structured six-week bilingual writing workshop (launching at the Egleston Square Branch).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a longer-term option for writers who want sustained instruction; highlights bilingual instruction as a program feature to reach diverse language communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic session topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Each drop-in session focuses on a unique theme, including natural disasters, immigration stories, and food.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Themed prompts aim to inspire varied storytelling and to surface topics relevant to participants' experiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teen programming (podcasting series)
rubrics_metrics.description: BPL’s Teen Central and GrubStreet will offer free teen classes, starting with a podcasting series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Youth-targeted offerings expand access to teens and introduce formats (like podcasting) that cross literary and media skills; future expansion to teen drop-in workshops is planned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive spaces and diverse readings
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshops create inclusive spaces and workshop readings highlight literature by international writers and authors of color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programming intentionally centers diverse voices and international literature to foster inclusivity and representation in workshop materials and readings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family-friendly / caretaker flexibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides flexibility for caretakers, allowing participants to bring their families to drop-in sessions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accommodations for caretakers reduce barriers to participation and create family-friendly workshop environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on access for underrepresented communities
rubrics_metrics.description: The program’s goal is to ensure everyone in the city who wants to participate in the literary arts has access to instruction and community, creating opportunity for communities currently underrepresented in publishing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on outreach and support to underrepresented writers, helping them hone their work and find audiences; framed as an equity and inclusion objective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership model and expansion intent
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaboration between GrubStreet and the Boston Public Library to relaunch and expand the Write Down the Street neighborhood program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program is a partnership leveraging GrubStreet’s teaching capacity and BPL’s branch network; leadership expresses intent to engage additional locations and expand teen offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program logistics: locations and schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific launch dates and locations: six-week bilingual workshop launches Friday, October 6 at Egleston Square; drop-in classes begin Tuesday, October 17 at Mattapan; teen podcasting series begins October 3.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical scheduling and location details provided for prospective participants; further program updates available via GrubStreet program page.
